title: zazzle command operations
description: The zazzle commands the daemon runs. Each is reached as `zazzle CMD ...` through the C invoker and the daemon's socket, as an MCP tool of `zazzled mcp` (except clean and status; the structure commands' tools are named with underscores, zazzle_find_symbol for find-symbol), or in-process as `zazzled run CMD ...`. help and version only print text and are left out; `zazzle run` and `zazzle proxy` are their own processes (src/wrap, src/proxy). A failure is one line starting `error:` with exit status 2.

entities.name: find
entities.description: Regex search over files, grouped by file with line numbers.
entities.transport: zazzle find PATTERN [PATH..] [-i -F -w -c -l -u] [-C N] [-g GLOB] [-m N] (alias grep); MCP tool zazzle_find
entities.authorization: Callers of the daemon's own uid (checked by the server); reads any file the user can read.
entities.result: Matching lines grouped by file (N: match, N- context), ranked ordinary files before tests and shallower first, at most 50 lines unless -m, with a footer counting matches, files searched and files skipped; -l and -c list files (and counts) instead, at most 200.
failures: No pattern: the usage line.
An invalid regex: `invalid regex: ...`, with a hint for look-around and backreferences.
A bad glob: `bad glob '...'`.
A path that does not exist: `PATH: no such file or directory`.

entities.name: read
entities.description: Numbered lines of one or more files, ranges or one named symbol.
entities.transport: zazzle read PATH[:A-B].. [--source --symbol NAME[(T1, T2)][#N] --around N --ctx N --head N --tail N --budget T --anchors --full] (alias cat); MCP tool zazzle_read (symbol, source and the rest as arguments)
entities.authorization: Callers of the daemon's own uid; reads any file the user can read.
entities.result: Per file a header (path, line count, the first 8 hex digits of its BLAKE3 hash, the range and any symbol) and `N<TAB>text` lines, or `N#xyz<TAB>text` with anchors; beyond the budget (default ~3000 tokens per file) the middle is replaced by the exact range to read next. A C# file without --source or --anchors comes as the indexer's terse view, and an HTML, Razor, Python, TypeScript or Dart file with something to shorten as zazzled's own terse view, both with no sha. Binary and empty files get a one-line summary.
failures: No path: the usage line.
A start line past the end, or a backwards range.
More than one of --around, --head, --tail, or one of them, or PATH:A-B, together with --symbol; PATH:A-B together with --around, --head or --tail.

--symbol that matches no symbol (similar names are listed), several (they are listed, numbered, to pick by parameter types or #N), parameter types that fit no overload (the overloads are listed), or a #N out of range.
--budget 0.
A missing, unreadable, non-regular or over 256 MiB file.

entities.name: ls
entities.description: A directory tree with file and line counts.
entities.transport: zazzle ls [DIR] [-d N] [-m N] [-u]; MCP tool zazzle_ls
entities.authorization: Callers of the daemon's own uid; lists any directory the user can read.
entities.result: The root with its recursive file count, then subdirectories (with file counts) and files (with line counts, or `bin` and a size) to depth 2 and at most 150 entries unless -d and -m say otherwise, with a note of what was left out.
failures: More than one directory: the usage line.
A path that does not exist.

entities.name: outline
entities.description: Symbols with line ranges for files or directories.
entities.transport: zazzle outline PATH.. [-d N] [-m N]; MCP tool zazzle_outline
entities.authorization: Callers of the daemon's own uid; reads any file the user can read.
entities.result: Per file its line count, then `start-end kind name` per symbol, indented by nesting, to depth 3 and at most 200 symbols; a directory contributes its outlinable files.
failures: No path: the usage line.
A path that does not exist, or a file that cannot be loaded.

entities.name: refs
entities.description: Where a symbol is defined and used; in C# files only where it is used as an identifier, not in comments or strings.
entities.transport: zazzle refs SYMBOL [PATH..] [-g GLOB] [-m N] [-u]; MCP tool zazzle_refs
entities.authorization: Callers of the daemon's own uid; reads any file the user can read.
entities.result: `defs` (up to 20, with their ranges and kinds) then `refs` grouped by file, each use with its line, its enclosing symbol and the clipped line, at most 50 uses unless -m, with a footer; `no references to NAME in N files` when there are none. In a .cs file, a line whose only mentions are in comments or strings is left out, and a file left with none is not listed.
failures: No symbol: the usage line.
A bad glob, or a path that does not exist.

entities.name: edit
entities.description: Changes or creates one file inside the working directory.
entities.transport: zazzle edit PATH --old T --new T [--all] --expect SHA | --lines A-B --new T (--expect SHA | --at A#xyz-B#xyz) | --after N --new T --expect SHA | --create --new T; `--new -` (and `--old -`) read standard input; MCP tool zazzle_edit
entities.authorization: Callers of the daemon's own uid; the path must resolve, after symlinks, inside the caller's working directory (confine); every edit except --create needs the sha or anchors of the version the caller read.
entities.result: One line `ok PATH: ...` saying what changed and the file's new sha. Never given a session id or deduplicated.
failures: A path outside the working directory: `refusing to write outside DIR (run from a parent directory)`.
A path with .. through a missing directory.
A binary file.
Neither --expect nor --at: `edits need --expect SHA (from read --source) or --at A#xyz-B#xyz (from read --source --anchors)`.

A sha that no longer matches: `PATH: the file is not the version you read; read it again with --source`; an anchor that no longer matches: `PATH: line N is not what you read; read it again with --source`.
--old text not found (with the lines that contain its first line), or found in several places without --all; --old empty.
Lines outside the file, a line past the end for --after, or a bad range.
The file changed between loading and writing: `file changed while editing; read it again`.
--create on an existing file.
A text of `-` with no standard input, or input that is not UTF-8.

entities.name: overview
entities.description: A compact map of the git work tree from zazzle-csharp-indexer's index; agents call it zazzle_overview.
entities.authorization: Callers of the daemon's own uid; the indexer's daemon socket is the user's own (mode 0600).
entities.result: The indexer's overview of the work tree: `<root>: N files`, then languages, top directories, entry and project files, and the largest files.
failures: Any argument: the usage line.
The working directory is not inside a git work tree: `error: not inside a git work tree`.
zazzle-csharp-indexer is not installed or cannot run: `error: zazzle-csharp-indexer is not installed (beside zazzled or on PATH)` or `error: zazzle-csharp-indexer --version: ...`.
The indexer daemon does not start within 5 s, refuses the hello or closes the connection: one `error:` line saying so.
The index is still building after 30 s: the indexer's index_cold error.

entities.name: find-symbol
entities.description: Declarations by name from the indexer's index; agents call it zazzle_find_symbol.
entities.transport: zazzle find-symbol NAME [--exact] [--kind K] [--limit N] [--offset N]; MCP tool zazzle_find_symbol {name, exact?, kind?, limit?, offset?}
entities.authorization: Callers of the daemon's own uid; the indexer's daemon socket is the user's own (mode 0600).
entities.result: `path:line kind container.name | signature` per declaration, paths relative to the working directory, exact matches first, 30 by default, then a footer with the count or the next offset.
failures: No name, or more than one: the usage line.
A number flag that is not a number: `--limit needs a number`.
The working directory is not inside a git work tree: `error: not inside a git work tree`.
zazzle-csharp-indexer is not installed or cannot run: `error: zazzle-csharp-indexer is not installed (beside zazzled or on PATH)` or `error: zazzle-csharp-indexer --version: ...`.
The indexer daemon does not start within 5 s, refuses the hello or closes the connection: one `error:` line saying so.

entities.name: changed-since
entities.description: Files added, modified or deleted in the work tree since a cursor; agents call it zazzle_changed_since.
entities.authorization: Callers of the daemon's own uid; the indexer's daemon socket is the user's own (mode 0600).
entities.result: Without a cursor, `cursor: ...`; with one, `A|M|D path` lines (relative to the working directory) and a new cursor. A cursor from an earlier run of the indexer's daemon is reported expired with a new one.
failures: More than one cursor: the usage line.
The working directory is not inside a git work tree: `error: not inside a git work tree`.
zazzle-csharp-indexer is not installed or cannot run: `error: zazzle-csharp-indexer is not installed (beside zazzled or on PATH)` or `error: zazzle-csharp-indexer --version: ...`.
The indexer daemon does not start within 5 s, refuses the hello or closes the connection: one `error:` line saying so.

entities.name: git-log
entities.description: Recent commits, optionally for one path and filtered by message; agents call it zazzle_git_log.
entities.transport: zazzle git-log [PATH] [-n N] [--grep TEXT]; MCP tool zazzle_git_log {path?, n?, grep?}
entities.authorization: Callers of the daemon's own uid; the indexer's daemon socket is the user's own (mode 0600).
entities.result: `hash date author subject` per commit, 20 by default.
failures: A path outside the git work tree: `error: PATH: outside the git work tree`.
git fails: git's message.
The working directory is not inside a git work tree: `error: not inside a git work tree`.
zazzle-csharp-indexer is not installed or cannot run: `error: zazzle-csharp-indexer is not installed (beside zazzled or on PATH)` or `error: zazzle-csharp-indexer --version: ...`.
The indexer daemon does not start within 5 s, refuses the hello or closes the connection: one `error:` line saying so.

entities.name: git-blame
entities.description: Who last changed each line of a range of a file; agents call it zazzle_git_blame.
entities.transport: zazzle git-blame PATH [--start N] [--end N]; MCP tool zazzle_git_blame {path, start_line?, end_line?}
entities.authorization: Callers of the daemon's own uid; the indexer's daemon socket is the user's own (mode 0600).
entities.result: git blame -w output for the range, 40 lines from --start by default.
failures: No path: the usage line.
A path outside the git work tree: `error: PATH: outside the git work tree`.
git fails: git's message.
The working directory is not inside a git work tree: `error: not inside a git work tree`.
zazzle-csharp-indexer is not installed or cannot run: `error: zazzle-csharp-indexer is not installed (beside zazzled or on PATH)` or `error: zazzle-csharp-indexer --version: ...`.
The indexer daemon does not start within 5 s, refuses the hello or closes the connection: one `error:` line saying so.

entities.name: report-gap
entities.description: The agent's sentence on what it needed and could not get; agents call it zazzle_report_gap.
entities.transport: zazzle report-gap TEXT; MCP tool zazzle_report_gap {what}
entities.authorization: Callers of the daemon's own uid; the indexer's daemon socket is the user's own (mode 0600).
entities.result: `recorded`, never deduplicated; the indexer stores the note in its usage log, where zazzle-csharp-indexer report lists it.
failures: No text: the usage line.
The working directory is not inside a git work tree: `error: not inside a git work tree`.
zazzle-csharp-indexer is not installed or cannot run: `error: zazzle-csharp-indexer is not installed (beside zazzled or on PATH)` or `error: zazzle-csharp-indexer --version: ...`.
The indexer daemon does not start within 5 s, refuses the hello or closes the connection: one `error:` line saying so.

entities.name: clean
entities.description: Shrinks the output of another command, piped in.
entities.transport: CMD | zazzle clean [--as auto|grep|json|text] [--lossless] [--budget T] [--stats]; not an MCP tool
entities.authorization: Callers of the daemon's own uid; reads only its standard input.
entities.result: The cleaned text, `(empty)` for no input, a note when input past 64 MiB was cut, and with --stats `[clean ~A→~B tokens; steps: ...]`. When the engine has an output store the answer starts with `[r:ID]`, a ten-character output id, and is stored with the input for an hour; when the input was cut or a lossy step or the budget removed something it ends with `[full output: read-again r:ID --full]`. A store that cannot be written leaves the answer untagged, ending with `[output not stored for read-again: ...]`. Never given a session id or deduplicated.
failures: A positional argument: `clean reads standard input only`.
An --as value other than auto, grep, json or text.
--budget 0.
No standard input available, or it cannot be read.

entities.name: read-again
entities.description: Gives an earlier answer back by its id: a session response run again, or a stored clean, run or proxy output as shown or in full.
entities.transport: zazzle read-again r:ID [--full [--lines A-B] [--budget T]] (the id may be written `r:ID`, `[r:ID]` or bare; --lines implies --full); MCP tool zazzle_read_again with id, full, lines and budget
entities.authorization: Callers of the daemon's own uid. A session response is rerun only for the caller's own session, in the working directory it first ran in, with the same flags, so it reveals no more than the original did. A stored output is returned to whoever names its id.
entities.result: Without --full, an id the caller's session holds is run again: the same text under the same id when nothing changed, else the current version under a new id with `r:OLD changed since it was sent; this is the current version`. Otherwise the stored output comes back as it was shown, under `[r:ID]`. With --full, the stored input comes back as `r:ID full output, N lines [A-B]` and `N<TAB>text` rows, terminal escapes and redraws removed; past the budget (default 3000 tokens) the middle is replaced by the `read-again r:ID --full --lines X-Y` that shows it. Never deduplicated.
failures: Not exactly one id, or an unknown option: the usage line `read-again r:ID [--full [--lines A-B] [--budget T]]`.
An id neither the session nor the output store holds: `no response r:ID in this session or the output store (stored outputs are kept for an hour); run the command again`.
--full for a session response, which was never cut: `r:ID was not cut; read-again r:ID gives it whole`.
A --lines range that does not parse (`bad line range`), or starts past the last line.
On a rerun, whatever the original command now refuses.

entities.name: status
entities.transport: zazzle status; zazzled run status (counters of a fresh in-process engine); not an MCP tool
entities.authorization: Callers of the daemon's own uid.
entities.result: One line: version, pid, uptime, hot and stored cache records with hits and misses, walks scanned and reused, and the number of sessions.
